permitted.text: Agents may cooperate on any task.

prohibited.text: Agents must never load the same task simultaneously. Each task can be collected alone.

conditional.text: If far is unfinished, do not attempt to load near. Cooperation is allowed.

exception.text: Do not cooperate, except on near when its level exceeds every individual capacity.

unrestricted_pair.text: Collect all tasks. Cooperation is allowed. No order is required.

heavy_permitted.text: Cooperation is permitted, including on tasks above individual capacity.
